tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 (slab, num_soil_layers = 5) bl_pbl=1, data/eqwefic/scm_ref) dumped by the instrumented ctessum-claude/WRF fork (commit e42a269, module_esm_dump hooks in module_sf_slab.F) and replayed through the real64 (-fdefault-real-8) standalone kernels/slab_driver at ESM_DT = 0.01 s. Inputs are the dumped SLAB arguments of tile column 1 (real32 values widened); every expected value is the real64 replay. SLAB1D is an explicit Euler step with nsoil soil sub-steps (nsoil = 2 at dt = 60 s), so its dt = 60 s ground-temperature change is NOT the instantaneous tendency (it differs by 0.4-11 % across the regimes); at dt <= 0.04 s nsoil = 1 and the dumped DTHGDT is the exact derivative at the initial state -- verified bit-identical for dt = 0.04, 0.02, 0.01 and 0.005 s, so no Richardson extrapolation is needed and the 0.01 s replay is used directly. Layer tendencies are asserted against SLAB1D's own arithmetic on the dumped real64 interface fluxes, -(FLUX(L+1)-FLUX(L))/(DZS(L) CAPG), and spot-checked against (TSLB_out - TSLB)/dt. Residual esm-vs-Fortran mismatch comes from the real32 WRF constants handed to the kernel (svpt0 = 273.1499939, svp1 = 0.61119998, ep2 = 0.62175041, rovcp = 0.28571430, stbolt = 5.6705101e-8) versus the nominal values of lib/wrf_constants.esm: measured with zero tolerances over the four regimes it is <= 8.3e-8 relative in theta_air, upflux, xinet, rnet, hm and hfx; 4.6e-7 to 2.6e-6 in qfx, lh, qs and qsfc (the Bolton exponent svp2 (T - svpt0)/(T - svp3) turns the 6.1e-6 K error of svpt0 into 4.2e-7 of es_g, and the saturation deficit qsat_g - qv_air amplifies it, most at night); and the cancellation in G = rnet - qs (|G| << qs by day) and in the layer-1 flux divergence amplifies it further to <= 4.9e-6 in G_sfc and <= 4.8e-5 in dTsk_dt = dTs_dt[1] (call 120: G = -32.6 W/m^2 out of qs = 270; the interior layers stay <= 1.9e-6, <= 1.7e-5 only on the ~1e-8 K/s tendencies of the isothermal regime). Tolerances are set 5-10x above the worst measured residual: rel 1e-6 on the radiative terms and hfx, 2e-5 on the moisture terms, 5e-5 on G_sfc, 5e-4 on dTsk_dt, Linf abs 5e-8 K/s on the tendency column (the layer-1 residual, <= 6.3e-9 K/s) and rel 5e-4 / abs 1e-11 K/s on the per-layer spot checks. Regime: call 120 (step 60, 20:00 UTC = 13:34 LST), midday: gsw = 315 W/m^2, rnet = 237 W/m^2, hfx = 71, lh = 199 W/m^2, G = -32.6 W/m^2 (the surface loses heat to the turbulent fluxes while the soil below is warming from the morning), soil warmer at depth (285.7 -> 288 K).
